name: Irving, James, Arthur
notes: Family entry for K.C. Irving's sons (Irving Oil / J.D. Irving, New Brunswick). All three brothers have died: John E. 'Jack' Irving in 2010, Arthur Irving on May 13, 2024 (Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arthur_Irving), and James K. Irving on June 21, 2024 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_K._Irving).

name: Ronald Southern
notes: ATCO and Spruce Meadows founder Ron Southern died January 21, 2016, in Calgary, aged 85 (https://globalnews.ca/news/2469107/atco-founder-ron-southern-dies-at-85). His daughter Nancy Southern now leads ATCO.

name: Alexander Spanos
notes: Real estate developer and Chargers owner Alex Spanos died October 9, 2018, aged 95 (https://www.kpbs.org/news/2018/oct/09/chargers-owner-alex-spanos-dies-at-95/). His son Dean Spanos is now the Chargers' controlling owner.

name: Djuhar Sutanto
notes: Salim Group co-founder Sutanto Djuhar (Liem Oen Kian) died July 2, 2018, in Fuzhou, China, aged 90 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sutanto_Djuhar). His son Tedy Djuhar is on the First Pacific board.

name: Bernard Lewis
notes: River Island founder Bernard Lewis died 28 February 2026, 18 days after his 100th birthday (https://www.jewishnews.co.uk/a-true-gentleman-who-quietly-led-from-the-front-tributes-paid-to-river-island-founder-bernard-lewis/). River Island is now led by his nephew Ben Lewis.

name: Alice N. Schwartz
notes: Bio-Rad co-founder and Director Emeritus Alice Schwartz died September 25, 2025, aged 99 (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20250929203438/en/Bio-Rad-Laboratories-Inc.-Co-Founder-and-Director-Emeritus-Alice-Schwartz-Passes-Away). Her son Norman Schwartz is Bio-Rad's chairman and CEO.

name: Peter M. Nicholas
notes: Boston Scientific co-founder and former CEO Pete Nicholas died May 14, 2022, aged 80 (https://www.fiercebiotech.com/medtech/boston-scientific-co-founder-former-ceo-peter-nicholas-dies-80).

name: Xie's
notes: Hurun family entry ('Xie family') for Zhongzhi Enterprise Group. Its founder Xie Zhikun died of a heart attack in Beijing on December 18, 2021, aged 61 (https://www.caixinglobal.com/2021-12-19/chinese-tycoon-who-built-zhongzhi-enterprise-group-dies-101819642.html). The group later defaulted and went into bankruptcy liquidation, and some relatives were part of a police investigation. No individual heir is identifiable. Not a viable outreach target.

name: Thomas James
current_role: Chairman Emeritus, Raymond James Financial; co-founder of the James Museum of Western & Wildlife Art (St. Petersburg, FL)
profile: Son of Raymond James founder Robert James, Tom James built the firm into a national financial services group over 40+ years as CEO and then chairman. He stepped down as chairman in 2017 and retired from the board in Feb 2024. He now focuses on art: he and his wife Mary opened the James Museum in St. Petersburg in 2018.
interesting_fact: Tom and Mary James have collected 3,000+ works of American, Western and wildlife art since their student days. Part of the collection hangs in the James Museum and the rest at Raymond James headquarters.
deep_cut_fact: He began buying art in the 1960s while at Harvard and playing gigs with a rock band. After a 1980s ski week in Aspen he walked into a gallery planning to buy three or four paintings and left with eight. He calls himself 'artistically inept' and has never tried painting.
notes: Retired from Raymond James. The best warm route is probably the James Museum, which he founded and still identifies with; use its contact form with the 'Press' topic. Raymond James media relations handles corporate inquiries.

name: James Packer
current_role: Private investor (Consolidated Press Holdings family interests); partner in the Nobu Beach Inn / The Beach Club, Barbuda development with Robert De Niro
profile: James Packer inherited and expanded the media and gaming empire of his father Kerry Packer, becoming the largest shareholder of casino operator Crown Resorts. He sold his remaining Crown stake to Blackstone in 2022. He now invests privately, and with Robert De Niro and Daniel Shamoon is developing a Nobu-branded resort and residences on Barbuda, set to open in late 2026 or 2027.
interesting_fact: Packer, Robert De Niro and Daniel Shamoon are building The Beach Club, Barbuda, a Nobu Beach Inn resort and residential community on about 400 acres and two miles of Barbuda's southwest coast, on the former K Club site.
deep_cut_fact: After finishing his HSC at Cranbrook School in Sydney, Packer skipped university and worked as a jackaroo on the family's Newcastle Waters cattle station on the Barkly Tableland in the Northern Territory.
notes: Very private and has no published personal or office contact. Consolidated Press Holdings has no public contact page. The most plausible indirect route is the Barbuda resort's (Nobu Hospitality) press office. He has spoken publicly about his mental health, so avoid that topic in outreach. He gives interviews only rarely, such as a 2024-25 interview with The Nightly.

name: Frank Sobey
current_role: Director, Empire Company Limited (Sobeys parent); President, ECL Properties; founding partner, Creative Destruction Lab Atlantic
profile: Frank C. Sobey is a grandson of Sobeys founder Frank H. Sobey and a son of Bill Sobey. He spent 36 years at Empire Company, retiring as VP Real Estate in 2014, and chaired Crombie REIT and its predecessor until 2019. The Sobey family's fortune sits mainly in Empire/Sobeys, Canada's No. 2 grocer, and he remains an Empire director.
interesting_fact: He is a founding partner of CDL-Atlantic, the Atlantic Canada site of the Creative Destruction Lab startup program, and sits on the board of the Canada-U.S. Fulbright Program.
deep_cut_fact: When he stepped down in 2019 he had chaired Crombie REIT for 13 years and its predecessor Crombie Properties for eight, and said he had been 'connected in one way or another with Crombie' for 40 years. Crombie is named after Crombie House, the family home in Abercrombie, NS, which displays the Sobey art collection.
notes: Hurun lists 'Frank Sobey' for the Sobeys fortune. The founder Frank H. Sobey died in 1985, so this is most likely Frank C. Sobey, though Hurun may be using his name for the wider Sobey family stake in Empire. board@empireco.ca is Empire's published channel to directors, and messages go through the corporate secretary. CDL-Atlantic (an entrepreneurship angle) may be a warmer hook.
